scripts.build:resources: cross-env STUDIO_NOVA_DESKTOP_BUILD=1 npm --prefix ../frontend run build -- --base=/ --outDir=dist-desktop && npm --prefix ../mcp-server run build
scripts.package:windows: electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.yml && node scripts/copy-installers.cjs && node scripts/write-download-manifest.cjs
scripts.package:macos: electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.yml && node scripts/copy-installers.cjs && node scripts/write-download-manifest.cjs
scripts.package:linux: electron-builder --linux AppImage --config electron-builder.yml && node scripts/copy-installers.cjs && node scripts/write-download-manifest.cjs
scripts.package:all: electron-builder --win nsis --mac dmg --linux AppImage --config electron-builder.yml && node scripts/copy-installers.cjs && node scripts/write-download-manifest.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:resources && npm run package:all
